source: Historical Basketball-Reference tables; current-season ESPN completed box scores

methodology.scope: NBA only; all 30 franchises; regular-season team performance
methodology.overall: Net rating = offensive rating minus defensive rating; no opponent-strength adjustment.
methodology.offense: Offensive rating in points per 100 estimated possessions, centered on that season's 30-team average.
methodology.defense: Defensive strength is that season's 30-team average defensive rating minus the team's defensive rating.
methodology.overall_rating: Net rating centered on the 30-team season average; positive is above average, negative is below average.
methodology.standard_deviation: Rating divided by the population standard deviation across the 30 teams for that season.
methodology.home_away: Home and away scoring splits use archived regular-season game results; neutral-site games are excluded.

metric_labels.ppg_allowed_home: Points allowed per game at home
metric_labels.ft_made_rate: Free throws made per field goal attempt
metric_labels.opp_rim_fg_pct: Opponent at rim field goal percentage
metric_labels.points_in_paint: Points in the paint per game
metric_labels.opp_points_in_paint: Opponent points in the paint per game
metric_labels.points_allowed_pg: Points allowed per game to PG
metric_labels.points_allowed_sg: Points allowed per game to SG
metric_labels.points_allowed_sf: Points allowed per game to SF
metric_labels.points_allowed_pf: Points allowed per game to PF
metric_labels.points_allowed_c: Points allowed per game to C

position_source.methodology: Opponent points per game by the provider-listed position; not individual on-court defensive matchup assignments.

2027.source_note: Current-season efficiency uses estimated possessions: the average of both teams’ FGA − offensive rebounds + turnovers + 0.44 × FTA. Pace accounts for overtime. League averages and standard deviations include teams with completed games. Missing values are shown as —; at-rim shooting is unavailable from this feed.
